summary: Iteration 120 — tested the KPI aggregation fix for support_tickets_assigned and the new /faq FAQ chatbot (backend + frontend). 10/10 asserting tests pass (1 skipped on preview DB where no team user has any assigned open support tickets to compare against — the metric query logic itself was verified via the catalog aggregation flag and endpoint shape). All chatbot flows work end-to-end: suggestions, memory across turns, 2026 spec overrides (100 cm sumo arena / 5 m racer track), logged-in ticket context, anonymous no-leak, escalation. Frontend /faq page: hero copy, 8 suggestion chips, thinking indicator, markdown rendering (<strong> and <a href='https://oll.co/...'>), thumbs-down → escalation dialog prefilled with last question. SEO: title 'OLL FAQ...', canonical=https://oll.co/faq, robots='index, follow, max-image-preview:large', FAQPage JSON-LD with 4 Questions. /shop regression — all 4 categories render.
critical_code_review_comments: faq_chat.py: _SESSIONS dict uses in-memory TTL GC — acceptable per spec but will not survive backend restarts. Fine for FAQ bot usage pattern.
faq_chat.py decodes JWT with its own HS256 secret from env. If JWT_SECRET env var is missing, every authenticated chat silently degrades to anonymous. Worth a startup log warning.
kpis.py _compute_support_metrics: the 'assigned' $or clause does not currently honour an `assigned_at` field even though the docstring mentions it. Not blocking but comment-vs-code drift.
faq_chat.py raise-ticket endpoint accepts an arbitrary dict payload — would be cleaner as a Pydantic model for consistency with FaqChatRequest.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 support_queries row via /api/faq-chat/raise-ticket (email=test_iter120@example.com, source=faq_chatbot) during escalation test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend chatbot replies take 4-10s (gpt-5.6-terra reasoning model) — keep ≥30s timeouts. The support_tickets_assigned 'open backlog' assertion test is skipped on preview DB because no team user has any `assigned_to` + status=open support_queries in preview. In prod with Kirti it will fire. Catalog aggregation flag ('max' for support_tickets_assigned, 'snapshot' for support_sla_breach_over_3d) is verified green.
